top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Only to Child for Whom Intended (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that the operation had over-the-counter medication that was being used for multiple children.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based upon the information obtained, a caregiver did not comfort an infant who was visibly upset.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.
